support.title: Support
support.meta.description: Where to get help, report issues, and understand support expectations for TypeWhisper.
support.subtitle: Use the right support path for your TypeWhisper platform and app version.
support.mac.title: macOS 1.6
support.mac.description: Stable release support for installation, permissions, dictation, file transcription, workflows, history, dictionary, snippets, integrations, local APIs, and model management.
support.win.title: Windows 1.0.9
support.win.description: Stable Windows support for installation, dictation, file transcription, workflows, integrations, local APIs, and model management.
support.ios.title: iOS 1.0
support.ios.description: Support for the stable iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch edition, including installation, dictation, keyboard, local engines, sync, and purchases.
support.beforeReport.title: Before you report a bug
support.beforeReport.item1: Include the app version and your OS version.
support.beforeReport.item2: Describe exactly what you expected and what happened instead.
support.beforeReport.item3: List the active engine, model, prompt, or profile if relevant.
support.beforeReport.item4: For macOS, attach the JSON diagnostics export from the Error Log when possible.
support.community.title: Community channels
support.community.description: For setup questions, workflow ideas, and quick checks, the community Discord is usually the fastest path.
